newsitem.title: USA: Liposome files S-3 for 7.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Liposome files S-3 for 7.5 mln shares.

text.p: Liposome Co Inc said Monday it is filing a registration statement on Form S-3 to register 7,514,346 shares of stock held by Ross Financial Corp, its largest investor.
It said all the shares are previously issued and that the registration will be handled as a shelf registration.
Ross bought more than one million shares from the company and another 6.5 million or so in the open market, said company vice president Brooks Boveroux.
The company said Ross reported the shares in its most recent schedule 13D filed on May 2 and said in that filing that it acquired the shares for long-term passive investment.
The Liposome Co is a broad-based biopharmaceutical company developing and marketing products based on lipid technology.
The company's shares closed Monday up 5/16 at 26-15/16.
